key.name: armed-color
key.description: Colour of the close buttons while the modifier is held, as a #RRGGBB string.

key.name: sound-enabled
key.description: Play a short sound each time a kill button is clicked. Follows the system setting for alert sounds.

key.name: sound-file
key.description: Absolute path of an Ogg Vorbis or WAV file to play instead of the bundled sound. Empty means the bundled sound.
